commands.description: Structured command definitions with per-command timeout and exit-code tolerance. Replaces the previous plain string array.

label.description: Human-readable name for this check, used in reports.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait before marking this command as timed-out. Defaults to the global agent timeout if omitted.

allowedExitCodes.description: Exit codes considered passing. Defaults to [0]. Use e.g. [0, 1] for commands that are expected to warn.

continueOnFailure.description: When true, a failure of this command does not abort the remaining smoke commands. Defaults to false.
